datasetMetadata.datasetName: Region III Contextual Agricultural Advisory Knowledge Base
datasetMetadata.systemType: Verified knowledge base + farmer profile/GPS + live weather + rule-based decision engine + weighted symptom matching. Not AI/ML.
datasetMetadata.keyPrinciple: The dataset stores verified agronomy; the algorithm evaluates farmer soil, crop, stage, GPS and live weather to decide planting/advisory status.
datasetMetadata.sourceCurrencyPolicy: Older agronomy documents remain referenced, but current varieties, pesticides, fertilizer products/rates and seasonal planting notices require confirmation with AGRITEX/current authoritative guidance.
